DECLARE @FechaMax DATE; SELECT @FechaMax = MAX(DATEFROMPARTS(nCosecha / 100, nCosecha % 100, 1)) FROM cartera.desembolso;
SELECT AVG(nMonto) AS Resultado
FROM cartera.desembolso
WHERE DATEFROMPARTS(nCosecha / 100, nCosecha % 100, 1) >= DATEADD(MONTH, -5, @FechaMax)
GROUP BY YEAR(DATEFROMPARTS(nCosecha / 100, nCosecha % 100, 1)), MONTH(DATEFROMPARTS(nCosecha / 100, nCosecha % 100, 1))
ORDER BY YEAR(DATEFROMPARTS(nCosecha / 100, nCosecha % 100, 1)), MONTH(DATEFROMPARTS(nCosecha / 100, nCosecha % 100, 1)) DESC
